counterarguments.text: A counterpoint to reading the rate hike as a sign of a steady tightening path: the statement frames policy as still accommodative and contingent on inflation returning to 2 percent, which could support a more patient pace than a mechanical hike sequence implies.

citations.quotation:
The stance of monetary policy remains accommodative, thereby supporting
some further strengthening in labor market conditions and a sustained return to 2 percent
inflation.
